purpose: Reconstruct the cycle-producing interfaces nearest the post-WP00 frontier. This is a target-selection ledger, not a comprehensive bibliography of all known Hodge cases.
claim_boundary: A listed theorem is prior art, not a GCL result. An open entry is not evidence of novelty. Selected-class algebraicity is distinguished from full cycle-class surjectivity.

source_refresh.material_change: The Forge baseline predates 2025-2026 results that settle the Weil-class obstruction for all abelian fourfolds and imply the Hodge conjecture for abelian varieties of dimension at most five. Those results materially change target selection.

families.variety_class: smooth projective complex varieties of dimension at most three
families.construction_mechanism: p=0 and p=n use component/point generators; p=1 uses Lefschetz (1,1); p=n-1 uses hard Lefschetz on rational Hodge structures to reduce to a divisor class and then multiplies by algebraic hyperplane powers.
families.target_use: protected completed boundary; excluded from HC-R021

families.construction_mechanism: Zucker's theorem gives a genuine codimension-two fourfold case. The current GCL source package records the theorem and its primary locator but has not reconstructed enough of the original 1977 proof mechanism to use it as a template for a new target.
families.arbitrary_input_scope: all rational Hodge classes on the stated cubic-fourfold family
families.source: Steven Zucker, The Hodge conjecture for cubic fourfolds, Compositio Mathematica 34 (1977), 199-209; MATHFORGE HC-SRC-ZUCKER-CUBIC-1977.
families.target_use: reject as prior art; mechanism not used for selection

families.variety_class: abelian fourfolds of Weil type for any imaginary quadratic field and arbitrary discriminant
families.classification: generation of every rational Hodge class after known Hodge-ring reduction
families.construction_mechanism: Markman first constructs algebraic Weil classes on split-Weil abelian sixfolds using secant sheaves, Fourier-Mukai/Orlov transport, and semiregularity. A product with a suitable Weil-type abelian surface adjusts an arbitrary fourfold discriminant to split sixfold discriminant; Schoen's degeneration/descent step then returns algebraicity of the fourfold Weil classes. Moonen-Zarhin/Ramon Mari structure results reduce the remaining fourfold Hodge classes to divisors plus Weil classes.
families.arbitrary_input_scope: all rational Hodge classes on abelian fourfolds
sources: MARKMAN-SECANT-ICM-2026 lines represented by Corollary 1.3 for the low-dimensional consequence

families.variety_class: all complex abelian varieties of dimension at most five
families.construction_mechanism: For dimension four, divisor classes plus now-algebraic Weil classes generate the Hodge ring. For simple prime-dimensional fivefolds the Hodge ring is divisor-generated; for non-simple fivefolds Moonen-Zarhin reduce to divisors and pullbacks of Weil classes from quotient abelian fourfolds. Algebraic pullback preserves algebraicity.
families.target_use: reject all dimension <=5 abelian targets as prior art

families.variety_class: polarized abelian sixfolds of split Weil type with imaginary quadratic multiplication
families.classification: construction of selected exceptional classes only
families.construction_mechanism: On a principally polarized abelian threefold X=Pic^0(C), Markman constructs secant coherent sheaves from unions of translates of Abel-Jacobi curves. Fourier-Mukai/Orlov transport produces a coherent object on X x X-hat whose normalized Chern character has a non-divisor Weil component. Equivariant descent yields a semiregular sheaf. The semiregularity theorem transports the algebraic Chern character across the connected split-Weil moduli component. Since HW is one-dimensional over K and K acts by algebraic endomorphism correspondences, one nonzero algebraic Weil class generates all Weil classes.
families.arbitrary_input_scope: all Weil classes; not asserted here to be every Hodge class on every special sixfold
families.target_use: reject split-sixfold Weil algebraicity as prior art; retain mechanism as construction template

families.variety_class: abelian sixfolds of Weil type outside the split discriminant locus
families.classification: genuinely open boundary for Weil classes
families.construction_mechanism: No current general algebraic-cycle construction is supplied. Mostaed explicitly isolates failure of existing routes at CM isolation, absence of the K-secant structure, and uncontrolled discriminant. Markman's semiregular secant construction proves the split locus only.
families.arbitrary_input_scope: open even for the distinguished Weil subspace outside the split locus
families.target_use: defer: smaller dimension but currently lacks an executable cycle-construction path

families.variety_class: generic polarized abelian eightfolds of split Weil type in the Q(sqrt(-3)) component generated from a principally polarized abelian fourfold X and X-hat
families.classification: genuinely open boundary with visible construction mechanism
families.construction_mechanism: Markman's general strategy reduces the generic Hodge ring to divisor classes plus the Weil subspace and shows that a single nonzero algebraic Weil class suffices. Section 12 gives an explicit secant object on a principally polarized abelian fourfold: for d=3, take six generic theta translates D_i, the union Z of adjacent intersections, a partial normalization nu, and the derived object [O_X -> nu_* O_Ztilde] tensor O_X(Theta). Its Chern character lies in span{exp(sqrt(-3)Theta), exp(-sqrt(-3)Theta)}. The missing bridge is the weak semiregularity question in Question 11.4 (or a direct proof of full semiregularity for the resulting Fourier-Mukai object), needed to transport algebraicity across the split-Weil component.
families.arbitrary_input_scope: for the generic-Hodge-ring locus, all codimension-four rational Hodge classes reduce to divisor polynomials plus Weil classes

families.variety_class: CM abelian sixfolds at McMullen-curve/Weil-locus intersections
families.construction_mechanism: Mostaed reduces non-emptiness for selected K to explicit Hecke-correspondence equations but reports the resulting Hodge-Weil classes as inaccessible to existing algebraicity theorems. Non-emptiness is not guaranteed and no relative or secant cycle construction is presently available.
families.arbitrary_input_scope: intersection may be empty; algebraicity of the exceptional classes remains open when nonempty
families.target_use: reject for HC-R021 now: vacuity/non-emptiness debt plus no cycle-construction bridge

selection.reason: It is source-defined, outside current theorem terrain, attacks a nontrivial codimension-four Hodge class problem, and has an explicit algebraic secant object with one sharply identified deformation-theoretic obstruction. The smaller non-split sixfold boundary is open but currently lacks an executable construction mechanism.
selection.non_implication: Selection does not prove the target, establish novelty or priority, or imply the Hodge conjecture outside the exact restricted class.
